name: Critical Effects (BC): Rending - Head
description: Black Crusade, Table 7-21 (p. 255). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: 1 level of Fatigue. No effect if the target wears a helmet.
-10 to Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill for [[1d10]] turns. Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or suffer Blood Loss.
Stunned for [[1d5]] rounds and Blood Loss. Any helmet is torn off.
Routine (+20) Toughness Test or lose the eye; augmetics can repair it. [[1d10]] Perception Damage.
The target's helmet is torn off. With no helmet he loses an ear instead: Deafened until medical attention, plus a Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or 1 permanent Fellowship Damage.

Roll [[1d10]] for the feature lost - 1-3: an eye; 4-7: the nose, [[1d10]] permanent Fellowship Damage; 8-10: an ear, [[1d10]] permanent Fellowship Damage. In addition, Blood Loss and [[1d5]] levels of Fatigue.
Permanently Blinded, Fellowship permanently reduced to [[1d10]], and speech is slurred. Blood Loss and Stunned for 1 round.
The target dies; his head lands [[2d10]] metres away.
As result 9. Everyone nearby must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility Test or take -10 to Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill Tests for 1 round.
